{{Quote|And here is where the interception was taking place.|[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker]]|<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Exile">''[[Legacy of the Force: Exile]]''</ref>}}
[[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lady of the Sith]] [[Lumiya]] secretly commandeered a '''second apartment''' in the [[Zorp House]] complex of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. Located on the two hundred eighty-eighth floor, the infiltrated quarters served as a relay station for [[Lumiya's datapad|her datapad]], which was installed and programmed to intercept various communications, as well as [[Chasin Document|intelligence files]] from the [[Galactic Alliance Defense Force]].
